notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 federation synchronization-point slice to source-derived clause 4 records. It covers one-shot label tracking, global and explicit-set registration, callback-model-correct registration confirmation, announcement tags, late-join expansion, achievement success/failure, and completion after the synchronization set is satisfied. The focused filesystem lanes treat the C++ registration-result callbacks as the one §4.15 HLA service, and prove the §4.16 announcement and §4.18 Federation Synchronized records are durable at their individual recipients before HLA_EVOKED callbacks. The bounded direct-delivery regression verifies the registration, announcement, and completion boundaries under HLA_IMMEDIATE; the original HLA_EVOKED regression retains the late-join and duplicate-registration paths. It remains source/test traceability only: distributed transport, protected review, catalog promotion, save/restore interaction, and conformance are outside this slice.
